title: App is not working
body: I picked out a few recipes from the physical magazine before last weekend to make for my mom’s birthday party. I was planning to use the app to follow the recipes but I couldn’t do anything inside the app. I could see the recipes that I had bookmarked but clicking on them just brought up an “oops” page. Very disappointing and I don’t think I can rely on the app at all.

title: Ugh
body: Thought I found a good recipe app, until I opened it today, and it said that I’m out of free recipes. Would’ve been nice to know before I downloaded it

title: BS
body: I found a recipe online that looked great. I ordered the ingredients, then went back to make it and it was all blurry. It looked like maybe I just had to download the app to see it again, but no, you have to pay. If I had known that from the start, I never would’ve used this recipe and ordered everything for it. Already $30+ in, I signed up for a month at $4.99 and will cancel. But that’s BS.

title: Login
body: Went to the website and get spammed with advertisement and a novel of a story telling me the backstory of the recipe. I get to the recipe and it’s blurred out because I don’t have the app. I download the app and the amount of time it takes to create an account just to access an app to view recipes is ridiculous. Trash

title: You have to pay
body: The app is free but you have to pay a membership to see the recipes. Such a waste. Used to enjoy their website and recipes

title: Truly awful app
body: Don’t bother with this app. I signed up for a subscription. App doesn’t recognize that even after I changed my password 6 times. I’m canceling my subscription immediately. Too many other cooking options without this much bs. Waste of time

title: I have an Account - Fix It
body: The app truly is appalling that I have an account. A paid membership that gets me the quarterly magazine. But when I try to look at a recipe it says it’s reserved members. I can only get to recipes on my computer but not on this app. Please fix it.

title: Must pay for recipes
body: If you are prompted to download the app when using the web browser version, don't bother. You can only look at two of the "non-subscriber" recipes, which are limited, without subscribing and even those are impractical because the subscription window pops up every time you try to scroll up or down and has to be closed again before you can proceed. If you specifically use delish recipes frequently and want to put your phone in "cook mode" it may be worth it, but for the occasional user there is no reason not to just use their browser page.

title: Bait and switch/pay to use
body: I was excited to use the app and find new recipes but after downloading and going through all the set up I find out without a subscription you cannot use the app. Seemed like it might have been an ok app but without so much competition, o expected more.

title: Meh
body: App asks for dietary restrictions and then completely ignores them when suggesting recipes. Was only able to view a couple recipes before you have to pay for membership.

title: This is absolutely predatory
body: Suddenly all of your favorite recipes are behind an app and a paywall. Wow

title: You are evil scum, terrible company
body: Can’t use their website anymore without half the screen begging you to use their awful buggy app. You can’t close out of their personal advertisement. They make you create an account to use their awful app. Then they will sell your data for profits :) truly evil people working here

title: pointless
body: users complained that the app was buggy and required constant logins while the website was free. it appears that instead of improving the mobile experience they made the website worse and covered the page with demands to install the app.

title: Everything is pay only
body: They let you download the app but any recipe that you click on is for 'members only' so nothing on it is truly free. I wish they would just say that upfront so I dont waste my time.

title: Can’t see recipe until you subscribe….
body: So people can’t see the recipe online, you make them download the app, and can’t see it on the app because they have to pay for a subscription? COME ON! You’re forcing people to get a subscription.

title: Literally does not work
body: If you click a recipe or try and search it just glitches out, but if you use the web app it pops up with a huge banner that blocks the page

title: Frustrating Log In Process
body: I’ve attempted multiple times to save my password for this stupid app and it never fails whenever I try to SIGN IN, it takes me to create an account. I wish I could get my $30+ back for not being able to access what I paid for. Extremely FRUSTRATING!!!!

title: Unable to use app
body: Will not let me sign in to application

title: Please stop pushing us to the app
body: Hey y’all. Website is great. Mags are great. Your app sucks. I just uninstalled because having to log in every time is annoying. Please stop trying to push people to your app or I’ll have to consider unsubscribing

title: App is terrible
body: Love the recipes but the app never works - won’t be continuing with my paid subscription

title: Buggy App
body: App has been inconsistent by all accounts. After the update today 7/10, all I see is a blank white screen. On other occasions, I had to sign in and sign out multiple times just to get the app to work. It doesn’t always save recipes either. Very frustrating as I am a paying subscriber.

title: App is great, when it works…
body: I love the recipes this app provides, however I find it incredibly frustrating that I pay for a product that doesn’t work. More often than not the app doesn’t work at all. It’s just a blank white screen once open… almost always.

title: An endless blank screen
body: This app literally won’t load no matter what. I install the updates, I hard refresh the app, I restart my phone, I reset my wifi, nothing works. I have to navigate to a web browser to get access to my recipes. This has happened over the last 2 weeks and isn’t going away.

title: Screen size
body: Unbelievable that it is only configured to be used on a phone. When I open it on my ipad (which I always use for recipes) it opens as if on a phone and doesn’t use the entire screen. 12/23/25, Are you every going to fix the app so I can use it in landscape mode, full screen on an ipad? Until then it is an app that I will not use!! 04/10/26 Still waiting for it to work full screen on an iPad. 07/07/26 still waiting. Guess this isn’t a priority.

title: Became greedy with subscriptions
body: The recipes are free on the delish website, it doesn’t make any sense paying for a subscription for using the app.

title: Better off using webpage
body: The app never signs in and always opens to a white page with zero boxes to interact with, the only way to get it open is by opening your page on the website then allowing it to open in the app, if you back out of the app to look something up, answer a call, screen times out, ANYTHING Then when you go back to the app it’s a black white page again. It feels like they constantly get the exact same feedback and roll out updates but nothing ever changes. Sad.

title: App sucks!
body: I am paying a monthly fee to use this app and more then half the time the app does not work. I love delish and the app when it works but I am about to cancel if they don’t fix this issue. I have been subscribed over a year and this seems to be a new issue.

title: Sound optional please
body: I listen to Spotify while cooking. The Delish app steals the sound. Please make sound off/optional. I use Delish in the browser due to this. And now... They're taking up like a fifth of the browser screen to get you to use the app. Very frustrating.

title: Terrible Business Plan
body: $5 a month when we’re just gonna find another way to look up recipes is greedy and counterproductive from a business standpoint. They would definitely make more money by providing the recipes for free while having ads. Idiots. 😭

title: Blocked by paywall
body: The website is littered with ads and sends you to the app. The recipes are now blocked behind a paywall on the app making it worthless. If you like their recipes print to pdf from the website and email them to yourself, or just find another service until they figure out how to make a decent app.

title: App Doesn’t Work
body: Paying $5 a month for an app that doesn’t even work. Everytime I click into it, the screen stays completely blank. I can not access any recipes. very frustrating.

title: What????
body: App won’t open.

title: Terrible
body: This app is absolute trash! Makes it seem like you can browse and save recipes. Nope you have to pay for a membership. Terrible product

title: Not good
body: I downloaded the app because I was looking at a particular recipe on the delish website and had about 12 popups before I just downloaded the app assuming it was better. I search the same recipe and found it on the app and it immediately tells me “this recipe is only for plus users” …it’s chicken quesadillas. I’m not paying to see a recipe I might not even end up using on an app I just downloaded and haven’t used once. Crazy experience.

title: Constant Issues!!! So Frustrating!
body: I constantly have issues with this app. I am always being asked to sign in and everytime I try to open it up later it acts like it’s opening and then goes to a blank white screen. It doesn’t matter if I close it out completely and retry. It works when it wants to. Nothing more frustrating when you are trying to cook or look at the shopping list and can’t get to the recipe you need.

title: Rarely works
body: This is probably the worst app I have ever used. The recipes are good, there’s plenty of variety, the lay out makes sense to me and is easy to navigate, but the app rarely works. It logs me out several times a day and often does not allow me to log back in. Not with a password, not with the email link, nothing. Just sends me to a blank page. And that’s if the app will even open, often it is just a white screen. In order to get it to open I have to delete it and reinstall…. Then we’re back to not being able to log in the next day or sooner. This really needs a lot of improvement especially for an app that is not free.

title: way too glitchy
body: practically unusuble with how often it crashed

title: Love this site but the app is terrible
body: Half the stuff I save never saves, sometimes the app won't even load, clunky and just bad

title: Not worth the money!!
body: I was in love with this app! It made making dinner so easy and refreshing! There is a wonderful variety to choose from and I would have used this app every day! Unfortunately, it is no longer free and I refuse to pay a subscription when I can find free recipes online. I am truly disappointed that there is no longer a free version.

title: No longer free
body: Literally downloaded this app couple of months ago and fixed a couple of great recipes. Now I can’t even view the ones I saved without a pop up screen saying members only and you have to pay $4.99 a month.

title: Gotta pay?
body: Yippee the app is free but if I want to view, read or use a recipe I have to subscribe for $30.00. Talk about a bait and switch? I’m sorry I downloaded the app.

title: Scam
body: Terrible customer support, multiple emails, no response. Paid for an annual membership, card charged, account has no access, been a month. Avoid. *Update* I’ve reached out twice with zero response

title: Paid only???
body: I found a recipe online and it directs me to use the app for easier navigation. I download the app and the recipe I was looking at is members only. What a complete waste of my time.

title: YOU NEED TO PAY
body: Its ok and all, then you need to pay. It lets you CLICK on 2 recipes. Then you can’t click on any more. If you want a recipe, just look it up online. This app sucks.

title: Do not download this app
body: It is a horrible app! Must be a member to see a recipe. So not free at all

title: Subscriptions suck
body: Was free and used it all the time, now they want a subscription to get recipes, no. That’s a waste of money when you can google recipes. Just had it for convenience

title: Requires paid subscription
body: Downloaded the app, created an account, and immediately discovered you have to sign up for a paid subscription. Wish I had known that before I created an account because more I have to delete all that. You only get to look at two free recipes (but some are not available at all) before you have to subscribe. I’m beyond done with subscriptions nickel and dime-ing us everywhere. Time to bring out my Betty Crocker cookbook.

title: Was great when free… now everything is behind a paywall
body: Used this app for months to get new ideas for dinner, now I use lost access to my saved recipes because they decided its members only now. How disappointing

title: Only premium
body: This was very deceiving. I found recipes online from Delish which I was able to view however they encouraged for the app. Once the app was downloaded, none of the recipes were able to be viewed without the premium membership and at $2.99 per month. This is ridiculous. Very deceitful Delish!

title: Why must I sign in every time I use the app?
body: I’ve never used an app (aside from a banking app) that made me log in every single time. Very frustrating, much rather use the website.

title: paywall for mid recipes
body: i used the site at first just to browse and find things that sounded good and easy to make, downloaded the app after it locked it behind a 'members only' banner to be greeted by the same thing in the app. I have to pay $5 a month for some food network stuff ?? not worth it and such a hassle to navigate

title: Used to be free, now charges for a premium membership
body: I used to love this app, it had great recipes and a very simple user interface. Have had it and been using it for about 4 months now but suddenly I tried to view a recipe I had saved and they are claiming it’s for the premium membership only now. Immediate uninstall and will never use again

title: downhill
body: it sucks how it used to be a free app that allowed you to explore new ideas. now it’s behind a paywall. I just hate how everything costs something even being able to see recipes. sucks, but oh well.

title: Subscription
body: Just another app wanting you to pay for a subscription you’ll forget about because all the recipes are mid and you’ll forget to cancel in a week.👎

title: Paywall? Really?
body: I find these recipes on Google all the time and I can’t use your app to view OR save them because I have to pay money. Capitalism is absolutely bonkers. You. Suck.

title: Money grab
body: An app to have and store recipes and they want you to pay for it. How pathetic! I’ll never use delish again. Disappointed.

title: Delish lol
body: $5 bucks a month?!? <deep breath> Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha No

title: Was a fan until the GREED
body: I wish I could write a spectacular review because the recipes I’ve made are incredibly yummy and the app is well layed out. Unfortunately delish which was completely FREE is now charging people money for a subscription to have access to their recipes. Just another big company gone greedy. I won’t be participating i IMMEDIATELY screenshot all the recipes in my library and promptly deleted the app. Capitalistic greed always ruins everything. No thanks.

title: Lousy App
body: App takes you to the website to sign in EVERY TIME - what’s the point of having an app? Also, search is horrible. Looking for Creamy Sun-dried Tomato Salmon with Orzo (exact name of recipe) yielded 27 results - that recipe was listed 26th. Meanwhile, searching for Salmon orzo sun dried tomatoes yielded ZERO results. I’ll be deleting app in a minute.

title: A complete buggy mess
body: I really wanted to like this app. Unfortunately, it just doesn’t work. From a search bar that lags and tries to input text you aren’t writing to recipes that never save no matter how many times you click the bookmark button - it’s a bad user experience. It honestly feels like I’m navigating around in a beta version app. I’ll stick to the website from now on.

title: Janky, Ad-Littered, Basic
body: I just signed up for an annual plan. Next thing I know, I’m seeing offers on the site for $10 less/year than what I just paid. So that wasn’t cool. Downloaded the app. The experience is as bad as the reviews suggested. Sluggish, disorienting, and still contains ads for subscribers. Pretty lame, guys — especially since they’re all the same ad and they all say “Activate Your Account”, which is misleading — I almost clicked one! Also clicking on the account icon, then menu, then Settings, then Edit Preferences takes me to, you guessed it, the onboarding welcome screen. Tried completing the onboarding to see if that would fix it and repeated the same steps. Nope — right back to the welcome screen as if I never even completed onboarding. Stay away from Delish until they get their act together. What a joke. Give me my money back. Actually, you can keep it, but I’m out of here.

title: They suck
body: I never review, but these guys issued an article with 100 fryer recipies and blurred them out unless you get their app.

title: Awful
body: This is the worst app I have ever used. Certainly not user friendly whatsoever. No way to Cancel through the app. Takes way too long to sign in. Search aspect is terrible. And the recipes are very common. I’m asking for a refund which I’m sure they won’t even respond. 0 stars

title: Does not open
body: I have downloaded this app several times and it still won’t work!

title: Can’t open recipes
body: The only thing this app needs to do is show the recipes. It crashes when you click to open anything. What a waste of a subscription, which has some serious privacy issues.

title: Awful
body: I didn’t even get past the sign in page. It wouldn’t let me accept the terms and conditions. It kept freezing and not allowing me to move forward. Awful, buggy app.

title: Nearly unusable
body: This app is glitchy and should not have been rolled out. I still use the website since it’s so slow, often won’t pull up my saved without going back to the top of the list so I have to start over again and the search function is too wide to make usable. I don’t normally write reviews but this is just awful.

title: App is horrible
body: Developer obviously never tried to use it after they made it. Formatting is not cooking friendly. I will go back to the online version.

title: Inconsistent
body: Some recipes look good- but many don’t have thumbnail pics and have to click into the recipe for a photo and some have videos on thumbnail but the videos aren’t there when you click into the actual recipe.

title: Bugs and can’t finish profile
body: So bad- can’t set up feed it just stops and crashes.

title: Pretty junky
body: Whenever I get an email about a recipe I try to look it up in the app. I can never find it! I type in the exact same recipe title from the email and it never finds it. It usually returns some random recipe! It’s so annoying. And it keeps telling me I’m out of articles. I have at least two active subscriptions going right now. How can you not find at least one of them?! It’s just so much extra work when there are some great feee recipe websites out there. Please do better.

title: What a WASTE!
body: I just got an air fryer, so I thought I’d look up recipes. So Delish gives me an ad for their app, I download it. I sign up, and do their preferences quiz…and then it gives me my recipe feed. And it is EVERYTHING. I. LEFT. UNSELECTED. I left sweets off the list, all I see is desserts and BOOZE…that’s really something that needs to be a preference we can choose. Especially people who DO NOT DRINK, or CANNOT drink. I got everything I didn’t want. Don’t bother with this app.

title: Worthless app
body: Why have a feature in the recipes that allow you to set a timer for the directed amount of time, when it clears after you leave the app? I’m not talking shutting the app down, I’m talking scrolling to another app while you’re waiting on your food to cook! What am I supposed to do sit there and stare at the delish app while my food cooks! I’m currently guessing when my food is going to be done cause your trash app cleared the timer.

title: Does not work well
body: Please make the app better if you are trying to have us use the app. I’ve been trying to add meals and it keeps redirecting me to this app and none of my meals are saved and then when I try and save a new one it keeps telling me sorry there has been a problem

title: Finally an App! but wait…
body: Delish has been my go-to place for recipes for years but I had always wished there was an app; and now we have one! However, the images don’t load pretty often on the search view and only loads once you actually click on the recipe, making it difficult to quickly see and find the one. UPDATE: app keeps crashing and isn’t even functioning- I have uninstalled and re-installed, doesn’t fix the issue.

title: Crashing!
body: App crashes every time I try to open it. I’m on iOS 26.1. Was really excited to use the app for a recipe tonight. Disappointed

title: I was excited for this
body: I still get emails from Delish, before the app, I could click the link in an email and it would take me to the recipe, now it takes me to the app, but not to the recipe. Usually I get an error. I was excited to see an app, but I’d rather go back to the website. Hopefully the bugs get worked out soon otherwise there is no point in me keeping the app.

title: Very Glitchy
body: App does not run smoothly. Some pictures and videos show errors, scrolling is terrible. It is too easy to accidentally click on a recipe while scrolling. There also needs to be a scroll bar on the side to show where you are.

title: App Functionality Stinks
body: With the incessant DoorDash adds, clunky scrolling, and lag cause me to rate this app 2 stars. The lack of an alarm bell or sound while using the timers in “cook mode” make this app rating a one star overall. I’m about to cancel my subscription and use something better.

title: Confusing
body: Why is an app for recipes sponsored by a company that wants you to order out from restaurants? Every 10 seconds of scrolling is a huge distracting video ad for DoorDash. I’ll stick with the 29 other recipe apps available.

title: Worse than website
body: Ever since Delish came out with this app, I cannot print a decent copy of their recipes. I don’t like the screen view of this app and I can’t cook off of it from just my phone/pad due to the limited view. When I try to print from the website now, half the page is taken up with a huge ad for the app. I will probably cancel my Delish subscription due to these changes

title: Good Food terrible app and website!
body: I am unable to enlarge the font or print the recipe even though I have paid for the app and website. It won’t recognize my sign in ! I’ll have to cancel since I can’t view the recipes I paid for!

title: App and website recipes not consistent
body: Coming into Thanksgiving, I am in search of keto friendly recipes. Found a lot of Delish’s website but forced to use the app if I want them for free. But the recipes I’m looking for aren’t found in the app. For example, on the website is “best-ever keto stuffing”. Opening the app from this recipe goes to the front page. Opening the app from “keto bread” recipe takes me to the keto bread recipe. Not the stuffing recipe. I wasn’t able to search for this stuffing recipe either. Not in the results. I simplified my search terms to keto and tried again. Another time with stuffing. No luck. The results that loaded were slow and not very responsive to touch. Several times in attempting to scroll it registered it as a tap and opened a recipe that I didn’t want. Loading times for these actions is too long. Know what didn’t have long loading times and improved scrolling? The constant huge door dash ads. It’s my first time interacting with Delish and came away disappointed. Deleting my profile I had to create.

title: Bummer
body: Delish now requires you to use the app and the app interface is garbage. You also can no longer see any images of the recipes that Delish sends you, as everything is blurred out when you click on an article. You sign in, and you are no longer looking at the e-mailed recipes, you just see the home page of the app. I will not be renewing my subscription. Bummer because I’ve been a subscriber for years.

title: Worst App
body: I’ve tried a dozen times to login to the app and was unsuccessful. Really hard to enjoy your recipes when I’m “out of free recipes” and your app won’t accept any of my attempts to try and create an account.

title: Subscription issues
body: Every time I use the app it tells me I need to subscribe, even though I have an active subscription. Makes it useless and a waste of time and money if every time I look at a recipe I get an “Oh no, you’re out of free recipes” error. I have enjoyed several of the recipes on the site, but I end up going with another free site because delish can’t get their app straight.

title: Frozen
body: Froze on the first prompt. So can’t really use it

title: Recipes- good. App- awful
body: This app sucks but unfortunately it’s the only way to access recipes now bc when I sign in, it auto opens the app. They send me push notifications that rarely work. Please, powers that be, stop forcing this app that doesn’t work on us.

title: Annoying
body: Everytime I open the app I have to re login. But that’s only if I can even get the app to work most of the time I just opens to a white screen and I can’t even use the app.

title: Need To Add A Preview Page Before The Recipe
body: I clicked on a recipe trying to see what was on it and preview some pictures of it and it used one of my free monthly recipes. The recipes are good though just annoying that I was trying to preview something and it used one of my recipes. I didn’t even end up making it.

title: Need to Pay
body: Seems like it’d be a great app if you’re willing to pay, otherwise you have limited free recipes.

title: Disappointed
body: I downloaded the app, made an account and while searching for dinner recipes every recipe was under a “members only” pay wall. Just doesn’t make sense to have to pay for recipes no thanks.

title: Not worth the $30 I spent
body: I wish I would’ve read reviews before paying for this. It’s not worth the money at this time, just read the articles online for free everybody. Will probably not be renewing my subscription.

title: Meh…
body: The app crashes all the time, unfortunately anytime you get an email with a recipe you wanna try those are all part of the subscription. They refused to pay for subscription recipes when the Internet is full of recipes for free. I will be unsubscribing from all emails and removing the app from my phone. I can’t even get the app open half the time.

title: App experience
body: Why do I have to sign into the app every time I open it?

title: Page freezes
body: It might be great, but I wouldn’t know because the screen to select my choices freezes and will not scroll for me to submit.🫤

title: Paywall
body: The food looks good… but all locked behind a paywall & you can’t pick certain foods you don’t like. Not paying when i can google other recipes for free!

title: Saving issues
body: It’s frustrating how trying to save a recipe results in a 50/50 if the app will actually let you or not. I see more error messages than not. I will wait a day, refresh, and have even checked for updates to not have the problem fixed after a week is beyond annoying.

title: Searches yield few results
body: I searched for crockpot chicken dinner and got one result. Seriously?!

title: Ads have to go
body: I love Delish but this app needs work. Delish is one of my most trusted recipe resources and I happily subscribe to their magazine - I have never had one of their recipes fail me. However I almost never touch this app as it crashes any time I try to open a recipe. I also find it annoying that ads remain for paid subscribers while the app itself remains so laggy - leave that for a free version. I do like the "I cooked this" feature and I would love to interact with the app more, but there are glitches every time I try to leave a note or review, watch a video, etc. A "recipe of the day" widget would be a nice feature to add to my stack (these are offered by NYT Cooking and ATK and draw me into the apps almost daily.) Hoping Delish gets on this and begins updating and improving in a more timely manner.

title: Crashing and slow app!
body: There are tons of great recipes, if only the app wouldn’t time out, lock up and crash. Uninstalling to find another.

title: I was so excited for this app, but…
body: Whenever you try to open the Delish emails or recipes in the app, it never takes you to the correct page. The emails and the app need to work together for it to be a good app, I think!

title: Nightmare of a Cancellation Process
body: Trying to cancel a membership for this account is horrible. I have been going in circles on the phone with them saying they can’t find my account, meanwhile I’m getting emails from them saying my account is renewing in a few days. Maybe this is a random occurrence, but very annoying. No option to cancel on my own either. If/when this ever gets figured out, I can promise you I will not be redownloading this app. I’m gonna give it 2 stars because the app itself was cool and gave me a good recipe.

title: Still needs some work
body: I was so excited for this app because I use Delish a lot, but I have been disappointed this far. I have articles saved on the website with recipes I’d like to try, but in the app you can’t view the articles, you can click on the file, but nothing is there. I decided to try the “fool proof” dinner helper, made my choices for quick healthy dinner, and got tons of recipes for drinks and desserts. While I am not opposed to those things, not helpful in the search for a quick dinner. So unfortunately the app still needs a lot of work and fine tuning. I’ve deleted it for now, but will keep an eye on it to see if it improves. If not, I’ll just keep using the website.

title: Not a great app
body: This app is really bad compared to when Delish was only a website. App freezes up, too many ads for a paid app, poorly organized. Wish it was just a website again

title: Love the recipes but the app rarely works
body: Nothing displays when I open the app and this has been going on for several days now. I have refreshed and restarted my phone multiple times. There’s no updates to fix any bugs. Currently back to using the website until this is fixed.

title: Too Many Ads
body: I pay for delish and it’s crazy to me that there is so many ads in the app when scrolling through recipes. There is an add for like every 4 recipes. And half the time it’s the same ad (not saying I want different ads, I want less ads!). You think the company would focus on making sure all the recipes had thumbnail photos but instead it focuses on having just a ton of ads.

title: Freezes & doesn’t have every article
body: just like the regular website it consistently does not load correctly. Multiple articles I’ve tried to read are not on the app, but once you download the app it will automatically take you to the app so I had to delete it to be able to find the recipes or articles I want. I know it’s new but should probably work on the actual website before we create an app that is also bad. Please do better.

title: Need an iPad version
body: Why oh why isnt there an iPad version? It is so much easier to follow a recipe on an iPad than a small phone screen. And why cant we print from the App??? I have to go to the website anyways just so i can print. And then the image of the recipe doesnt print, only the stupid ad for the app. 🤦‍♀️

title: Poor app
body: The app is a pretty bad experience as compared to other cooking apps I have or have tried. The search function is spotty. One of my saved recipes disappeared from my folder (it still existed on the app - I found it again and re-saved it). Scrolling is jerky and slow as if we’re back to using AOL dial up. The recipes seem good, though I’ve only saved four of them because I dislike the experience. These should all be easy fixes in 2025. Disappointed.

title: Room for improvement
body: Really lags and app freezes a lot

title: So frustrating that music apps stop when using delish
body: It's impossible to keep music playing while having this app open. Extremely frustrating when you're trying to browse recipes

title: Doesn’t deliver as promised
body: So lacking compared to the website. Why can’t I scroll through ALL my saved recipes. Stops after 20…every time. Why doesn’t search deliver all the recipes I see online when requesting a specific category? This app needs MANY fixes to be useable.

title: Website was better
body: The app definitely needs some work. The website was better and easier for finding recipes, but now that there is an app they’ve practically made the website unusable.

title: Lack of recipies
body: I signed up with delish for a year and I am surprised that there is not more recipes. I hope they add more variety daily!

title: Needs and iPad version
body: What be nice if there was and iPad version of this app.

title: App performance issues
body: I’m a new subscriber so haven’t used it long. I have some vision impairment. When I open the app, the screen fills with multiple moving videos for random recipes in the scroll list. This gives me an instant headache. This app behavior continues whether I scroll through the home list or use the search. It is unpleasant to continue regular use because of this programming. There is no setting to turn off video autoplay. Also, the app is not ipad-friendly and oriented only to phone use. Thus, i can’t make it display larger to meet my vision needs. This isn’t facebook or instagram - i will not endure these irritations while paying for a subscription.

title: Great Recipes Bad App
body: I love the recipes on the app but the app it’s self is glitchy, often doesn’t open, and I almost always have to log back in when I open it

title: App needs improvement
body: Recipes are good if you can get them to load. App needs work- crashes often, pictures and videos don’t load…why pay money when you can only access a few recipes. Ready to cancel.

title: Used to be great
body: Whatever new update got put through today literally doesn’t work. It just goes to a white screen after the logo screen. I’ve tried uninstalling and reinstalling but no dice. Please fix so I can enjoy the recipes again!

title: Needs improvement
body: I’ve been without the app for 2-3 weeks and have contacted customer support twice via email and haven’t heard a response. When I open the app it just shows a white screen and content never appears. I’ve tried turning my phone off and back on but the app still isn’t working. I’ll try removing it and installing it again but I’m disappointed that I haven’t heard back from Delish customer service since I am paying to use this platform. Prior to this issue, nearly every other time I opened the app, I’m redirected to login through web browser. I’m hopeful they will improve and keep me logged in the app, since the point of an app is to avoid the web browser. My audio also stops when I open the app. I’ve been using Delish for years and have liked it, but this app has given me a lot of issues.

title: Buggy but useful
body: I really do like this app, but it consistently presents issues. Half the time it doesn’t remember me and makes me log back in, sometimes it opens up to a blank screen so I have to go to google and look up the website just so it’ll take me to the app and open properly, and the fact that it shuts off my audio on whatever i’m listening to is also rather frustrating. I love Delish, and I use it - app or website - multiple times a week, I just hope they can continue to figure out the kinks.

title: Too many adds hard to navigate
body: I want to love this app, that is why I subscribed. The experience has been less than I had hoped. The pictures are are too big on the landing page. The app is disorganized to a fault and the adds are everywhere. I pay for the app so I shouldn’t have ads. The recipes that I find have not been stellar. I have better luck searching on line outside of your app to find a specific type of recipe. I’m disappointed.

title: Great Recipes - Horrible App
body: I subscribed to the membership because I liked the recipes I found on their website and was excited about an app existing as I use my phone when I cook. The app is so laggy that it’s inconvenient to look up recipes on it. I’ve resorted to saving them online and only using the app to pull them up to start cooking. It does turn off any music you’re playing which is annoying and I feel like the screen goes off even with “cook mode” on. I think they have the right idea here but need their developers to do better.

title: Glitchy
body: I really love this app, however, I actually pay to be subscribed to this and it’s very frustrating that it’s so glitchy all the time. I’m trying to scroll and it’s constantly reloading and bringing me back to the top of the page. I was really excited when I saw there was an app instead of just the web browser, but it is still just as bad.

title: Ads Galore & Logs Out
body: Annoying to have a paid subscription and still be bombarded with ads. Plus frequently logs me out even though I have an account

title: Can’t print
body: Great recipes but you cannot print them.

title: No Music
body: My music pauses every time I open this app. I can’t listen to music and cook at the same time? Why would you rob me of this joy?

title: Needs a UI make over
body: I love delish’s recipes, but the mobile app isn’t enjoyable to use. Exploring new recipes is difficult because of lag and advertisements placed in awkward spots that make it hard to scroll.

title: Paying For Ads!
body: Ugh! This is a paid subscription but there are still ads. I can’t scroll through 4-5 recipe headers without encountering an ad for, ironically, DoorDash. (Yeah, I know they do more than meal delivery but still…) Why am I paying to see ads? I could more than understand if there was a free version and you had to watch a “full ad” to save a recipe, as well as the click bait ads between recipe suggestions, but it’s a big fat no for me, 100% because of the ads. Also, there isn’t a free version… so I literally had to pay to see some holiday recipe ideas interspersed with ads… I would probably have kept the membership, because the recipes seem to be relevant to the search terms, have different skill levels, and the UI is set up well. But did I tell you that you are paying for an app that has ads, even after you spend money on the app?

title: Could be perfect with some fixes
body: I know this app is new and I’m confident it’ll improve with updates, but there’s one major issue that’s keeping me from a higher rating. Aside from the occasional lagging, I cannot listen to anything while this app is open. As soon as I open it, my audiobook, music etc stops. That fact that I can’t listen while I cook is a surprisingly big issue for me. I’ve found myself screenshotting the recipes and having to swipe back and forth between photos.

title: Great content
body: Now that the app has been updated it’s very helpful with day to day meal planning!

title: DON’T DOWNLOAD
body: I ended up paying for this app twice because it wouldn’t log me in. After paying for a second time still couldn’t access paid version. Sent an email to the company with proof of purchase and never received a response.

title: It’s good but could be Great
body: I used the online all the time even with the lag here and there although the app has it to its tolerable but what I really miss is the shop recipe button that puts all the things you need for the recipe in a cart for you…I will still use the app to cook love the recipes

title: App crashes frequently
body: Whenever I select a what’s new recipe and he app crashes

title: SO Excited for the App! But…
body: I have been a Delish subscriber for several years and I was thrilled to hear they FINALLY developed an app! The UX is generally good for both iPhone and iPad. My only complaint is that it doesn’t let me play music in the background! It always stops my music playing from Spotify playing in the background even if I bring my widget menu down to press “play” again. Still it will pause the music! Make it quit that and you get a 5 star app 🥳😊

title: Great idea th
body: The app is great, I am a longtime delish subscriber and I’m stoked about this release. It’s unfortunately glitchy and difficult to scroll through recipes on the main page, however once you have them saved it’s easy to scroll around in individual recipes.

title: Delicious and accessible
body: Delish recipes are people pleasing and accessible in every way. Meaning, the ingredients are easy to find, the cooking methods are familiar to most I would imagine and the result is always fabulous. It’s definitely a go to for me and my family is always appreciative.

title: Artistic Flavor
body: All recipes I’ve seen on the site has been a wonderful display to inspire new recipes.

title: Make something New for Dinner!
body: Tons of recipes in this App. If you are looking to mix up your dinner rotation, I highly recommend the Delish App. I was tired of making the same things over and over for dinner. I found some great new favorites here! Lots of recipes for deserts, salads & apps too!

title: Ideals
body: Awesome ideals to fix what you crave!!!

title: Best oven baked ribs
body: Fall off the bone delicious! I never thought I would like oven baked over the grill❤️

title: On par or better than other cooking apps.
body: I’ve used several different cooking apps over the years and Delish blows them out of the water with features, content, and design. Most apps give you recipes but Delish makes it an experience that anyone can enjoy. And at this price point, it’s insane you get all of this for less than a cup of coffee each month. Let’s eat!

title: My favorite way to cook!
body: The Delish app is great! So many options to choose from and makes cooking dinner faster and easier. Plus, I love how easy it is to just hit a button in the recipe to get a timer going!

title: LOVE
body: I love delish’s recipes! I’m so happy I have them all in one easily accessible place now. I particularly love the ability to save and organize all my favorite recipes.

title: Amazing Recipes!
body: I really enjoy using this app. The recipes are tasty, easy to make, and well organized. It’s perfect for anyone who loves cooking or wants quick meal ideas. Five stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

title: Great app
body: I’ve been using the app for a while. I like the feature to keep The recipe always on. It’s quite handy while cooking

title: I love how easy this app makes finding new recipes!
body: ★★★★★ There are so many fun ideas, and everything feels approachable and simple to follow. It’s especially helpful when I’m not sure what to cook and need some quick inspiration. Definitely a great app for anyone who loves trying new recipes!

title: Really helpfull
body: Delish is a great recipe app with easy-to-follow instructions and a wide variety of delicious meals. It’s user-friendly, inspiring, and makes cooking at home simple and enjoyable. Highly recommended!

title: Consultant
body: Just discovered a great recipe app—simple, inspiring, and full of delicious recipes! 🍴

title: Love this app
body: Soooo helpful

title: Pretty Fire
body: I appreciate the easy to navigate features and fun recipes

title: Beautiful App
body: The pictures are beautiful and the timer functionality is a game changer

title: High Protein FTW
body: Needed easy healthy recipes and this app did the trick

title: Awesome!
body: Love the creative recipes!

title: Obsessed!
body: Having so much fun with this app!!!

title: SO helpful!
body: Looks great and is very easy to use!

title: The best of the best
body: No other recipe app can compete!

title: Amazing user experience!
body: As someone who hates cooking, I’m so excited for this app! I’m a visual learner so I absolutely love all the recipe videos. Plus other features like keeping your screen unlocked while you cook—so smart.

title: Perfect recipes for every occasion
body: Regardless if we are hosting a casual night with friends or having family over, this app has every single recipe under the sun to host a perfect party. Not only do they have food recipes but the cocktail recipes are ideal for large groups to batch ahead of time so you can be present with guests.

title: Awesome!!
body: So easy to use. Recipes are great. True game changer

title: Great help!
body: Phenomenal app. So great to use when looking for delicious new meals. Can’t wait to plan my next meal!

title: My favorite mag
body: Finally my favorite magazine has a recipe app! I’ve used these recipes for my girls nights, can’t wait to use the new features for my Thanksgiving dishes.

title: App of the year
body: I’ve always wanted to be a great cook, and now I can be with Delish. I’m happier, more confident, and better with woman after getting this app.

title: Great app for recipes
body: I love Delish and am so happy to have their recipes at my fingertips. The cook mode for recipes is great, so much easier to use than the browser on my phone.

title: Finallyyyyy
body: Finally after so many years of following delish I get an app I can use. Super excited to use it and make all my thanksgiving recipes which are my go to only from delish. Also happy I get a magazine.

title: My new go-to dinner app
body: My favorite part of this app is the dinner finder. I’m always looking for inspiration for what to make for dinner tonight and Delish has so many quick and easy (and delicious!!) options!

title: Such great features!
body: I LOVE the cook mode on this app. And having the in-recipe timer is a game changer. The dinner quiz is so fun! This app has everything I’ve always loved about Delish recipes and makes it just a joy to cook from.

title: Easy to use
body: I love that I can search for recipes depending on my friends and family’s dietary restrictions. Makes hosting so much easier!!
